Summary of the websites shared in #general:
• www.informations.com: A brief jobs-report update says unemployment edged down to 7.2%, bringing a mix of relief and concern.
• www.restaurant-zurich.com: Zurich Restaurant presents itself as a cozy, alpine-inspired Swiss eatery with traditional dishes such as cheese fondue, rösti, and chocolate fondue. It highlights rustic wooden interiors, Swiss memorabilia, panoramic city views, and friendly staff in traditional Swiss attire.

Hi Dora! I visited www.dora-website.com. The brief introduction and contact email make it easy to identify the site as yours and get in touch. Based on the content I could access, I'd love to see a little more about you—such as your interests, projects, or a short bio—to give visitors a stronger sense of your personality. Separating contact information from account-invitation notes would also make the page clearer.

Hi Eve! I visited www.eve-blog.com. Your introduction makes your enthusiasm for hiking clear—a great starting point for a personal blog. Based on the content I could access, I'd love to see trail stories, photos, or practical hiking tips to give readers more to explore. A favorite-hikes post with difficulty levels and highlights could be a useful first addition.
